impact: Small, months-old trades, so little signal; they touch MU and MSFT in Clement's book but do not change the picture for either.
summary: Rep. Harriet Hageman (R) filed a disclosure on Nov 23 showing a Micron buy ($1,001-$15,000, traded Jul 2), an Nvidia buy ($1,001-$15,000, traded Apr 29), and two Microsoft sales ($1,001-$15,000 each, traded Jul 2 and Oct 14). The filing also lists an Uber sale and a Pfizer buy.
title: Rep. Hageman buys MU and NVDA, sells MSFT (filed Nov 23)
